purpose: Measure whether local CPU-only, open-weight Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct can support a matched role-supervision fine-tuning experiment without downloading data or changing the synthetic confirmation.
device: CPU; two PyTorch threads; no MPS available in the installed environment
adapter: Manually implemented rank-four LoRA on every q_proj and v_proj, alpha eight, base model frozen
example: One active sentence and a question about its actor; assistant target is the actor name. Two 10-way heads predict actor and patient from the hidden state immediately before answer generation.
objective: Assistant next-token cross-entropy plus 0.5 times the mean of the two role-classification cross-entropies.
run: Five optimizer updates on one fixed example, batch size one; record step times, final losses, parameter and gradient counts, and process peak RSS. Do not save or evaluate this model as a research outcome.
gate: If finite gradients reach LoRA and heads, all five steps finish, and projected training time is tractable, design and freeze a full matched training study. This is not evidence that LLM roles were repaired.
